title: How does Pinnacle Blooms Network handle kids resistant to therapy?
metaTitle: Handling Therapy Resistance - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand how Pinnacle Blooms Network's seasoned therapists constructively deal with children who might initially show resistance to therapy.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that therapy might be a new, and understandably confusing, environment for your child. Our seasoned therapists use innovative strategies customized to your child's comfort, likes, and pace. Techniques like introducing them to activities they enjoy, creating a secure and welcoming environment, and empowering the child with choices can often help in easing them into therapy, making it a positive and enriching experience.
